product.name: Aquarius Hydro Wall Mounted Basin Mixer Tap Brushed Brass
product.description:
The Hydro range of taps from Aquarius have been created from the intricate flow of water with its sweeping design and rounded edges blending seamlessly with the water smoothly flowing from it almost becoming an extension of each other. The range comes with many options of taps in the three most popular colours of chome, black and brushed brass. The range is manufactured as always to exacting standards using the very best practices and materials. The items are made using brass as the core material, aerator spouts for that spa feeling and ceramic disc technology in the valves.

Many of the items are also WRAS approved which we think is something worth boasting about! So what is WRAS approval? The Water Regulations Advisory Scheme is a certification mark that demonstrates that an item complies with the high standards set out by water regulations. The regulations are in place to prevent the misuse, waste, excessive consumption and inaccurate measurement of water and, above all, to ensure the water is free from contamination. And all of these factors are tested by independent laboratories meaning it is one of the most trusted certificates in the plumbing world.

The Corwin radiator is a traditional style masterpiece that effortlessly combines timeless elegance with modern functionality. Inspired by the conic cast iron radiators, this horizontal wonder is here to revolutionise your space with its classic charm.

With a triple column design and made from high quality mild steel, Corwin guarantees an exceptional heat output, ensuring your room stays cozy and warm even on the coldest of days.

With its traditional columns and cast iron look, this radiator pays homage to the timeless designs that came before it. Finished in a rustic brass colour, this classic touch adds a touch of refinement to any interior, effortlessly blending in with both contemporary and traditional decor.

To complete the traditional style, optional radiator feet are available to purchase separately.

Please note that radiator valves are not included with this product, allowing you the flexibility to choose valves that suit your preferences.

product.name: Aquarius Foundry 3 Column Horizontal Radiator in White -  400 X 425
product.description:
The Aquarius Bathrooms Foundry 3 Column Horizontal Radiator brings a classic appearance to your home while offering an ideal solution for heating larger rooms. This horizontal radiator fits under windows or along open wall spaces to deliver constant warmth. Finished in a white coating, the traditional column look complements period properties or adds contrast to modern interiors.

This radiator connects to central heating systems only. It utilizes premium stainless steel to ensure excellent heat retention.

Please note: Radiator valves are sold separately, allowing you to select your preferred style options to match your piping and valves.

Why Choose a 3 Column Radiator?

A 3 column radiator features three rows of vertical pipes inside each section, rather than one or two rows. This specific construction significantly increases the surface area of the radiator. When there is more metal in contact with the air, a higher heat output is achieved. This makes it a great choice for boosting temperatures in cold, larger rooms.

product.name: Aquarius Foundry 4 Column Horizontal Radiator in White -  400 X 830
product.description:
The Aquarius Foundry 4 Column Horizontal Radiator delivers a modern interpretation of the classic multi-column radiator design. The pure white finish is versatile enough to sit alongside the organic textures of oak wooden floors and soft woven fabrics. It blends seamlessly into gentle colour schemes like sage green, cream or beige interiors. For homes with bolder design choices, the radiator provides a striking contrast against deep navy or grey walls, adding a modern edge that coordinates beautifully with contemporary furnishings.

Why Choose a 4 Column Radiator?

A 4 column radiator is built with four distinct rows of vertical tubing within every section. This configuration provides a deeper profile that packs a larger surface area into a compact footprint.

It offers a higher heat output capacity compared to 2 or 3 column designs. It distributes immense, steady warmth and continues to radiate residual heat long after the heating system turns off. This makes it the ideal choice for colder spaces that require thermal efficiency.

This radiator is for central heating networks only and is made from stainless steel for rapid heat distribution.

Please note: Radiator valves and feet are sold separately, giving you complete freedom to select your preferred style options to match your piping and valve preferences.

product.description:
This Rubber Wire Reinforced Hose is a heavy-duty industrial hose designed for demanding fluid transfer applications where strength, pressure resistance, and durability are essential. Manufactured with a smooth black synthetic SBR rubber inner layer, it provides reliable flow characteristics and resistance to wear during continuous use. Reinforced with two-ply fabric cords and a steel wire spiral, the hose maintains its shape under suction and pressure, preventing collapse and improving safety during operation.

The outer layer is constructed from smooth black synthetic SBR rubber, offering excellent resistance to abrasion, weathering, and general site conditions. Designed to operate within a temperature range of -20°C to +80°C, with peak resistance up to +85°C, this hose is suitable for industrial, agricultural, and engineering applications where dependable performance is required.

With a working pressure rating of 10 bar and a bursting pressure of 30 bar, the hose delivers consistent performance in both pressure and vacuum systems. Manufactured to SAE J20R3 standard, it is ideal for suction, discharge, fluid transfer, and general-purpose industrial use. Supplied in 20 metre coils, this wire reinforced rubber hose provides a reliable solution for professional users requiring flexibility, strength, and long service life.

product.name: Shower Seal for Screens Doors or Panels, Fits 8, 9 or 10mm Glass, Seals Gaps Up to 15mm, 1400mm Length, SEAL048
product.description:
This shower seal is comprised of a high quality rigid PVC U section designed to comfortably grip any glass ranging from 8mm to 10mm thick with no need for any additional adhesive. The bottom of the seal has a soft flexible fin and bubble which will seal any gap from 5mm to 15mm.

These seals are commonly found on either the bottom horizontal section of a bath screen or shower door, and can also be used vertically on the upright of the glass to create a seal between the glass and the tiles or wall. Please note that this is a straight shower seal designed only for use on straight glass.

This product comes in 800mm, 900mm, 1400mm or 2000mm lengths and can be cut down to size once you’ve received it.

Installation of our seals is nice and easy. Simply push the seal onto the glass from below on one end and work your way along, pushing the seal up onto the glass as you go. Do not try to slide the seals along the glass as this can damage it.

If you're struggling to find the correct seal for your shower/bath screen then please don't hesitate to get in contact with us. We would be more than happy to help.

The lightweight yet strong aluminium construction resists corrosion and performs reliably in both automotive and industrial environments. These joiners are ideal for use in turbocharger systems, intercoolers, radiators, and custom intake/exhaust setups. Compatible with silicone, rubber, and other flexible hoses, they maintain a strong grip when used with standard hose clamps. The smooth internal bore promotes optimal airflow or fluid transfer without turbulence or restriction. Available in a wide range of diameters from 13mm to 102mm, offering easy integration into custom pipework setups. Whether you're repairing, upgrading, or building a new system, these connectors deliver strength, reliability, and clean aesthetics for a polished result

product.name: Rivena 1200x500mm Chrome Heated Towel Rail - Slimline 12 Bar Ladder Radiator
product.description: The Lumora Rivena is a chrome central heating towel radiator measuring 1200mm high by 500mm wide with a 74mm depth. It connects to your existing wet central heating system in place of a standard radiator, so it warms up whenever your heating is on. It is not an electric towel rail, it is not dual fuel, and no heating element is supplied or can be fitted. Heat output is 908 BTU (266 watts) at Delta T50, the standard UK test condition, rising to 1,146 BTU (336 watts) at Delta T60. That is enough to act as the sole heat source in a bathroom of up to 3 square metres. The frame is low carbon mild steel with a chrome finish chosen to cope with daily bathroom humidity, carrying 12 bars across the 1200mm height. Water content is 3.8 litres, maximum working pressure is 6 bar (pressure tested to 8 bar) and maximum water temperature is 75 degrees Celsius, which suits both sealed and open vented central heating systems. Connections are 450mm side connections with half inch BSP threads - measure your existing valve positions before ordering. Wall brackets and fixings are included in the box. Radiator valves are sold separately so you can match them to your pipework and to the finish of your taps and shower. Installation should be carried out by a qualified plumber.

product.name: 48mm 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector Black Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description: This 45 Degree Plastic Hose Connector is a practical solution for creating smooth, angled connections between hoses. Manufactured from tough, lightweight ABS plastic, it offers excellent durability and resistance to weathering, corrosion, and everyday wear. The 45-degree design helps reduce hose stress while maintaining steady water flow, making it particularly useful in spaces where a gentle directional change is required. With its barbed ends, the connector ensures a firm grip on the hose, preventing leaks and slippage even when used under pressure. Perfect for use with garden hoses, pond hoses, aquarium setups, or general water systems, this connector supports efficient water management in both domestic and professional settings. Quick and easy to install, simply push the hose ends over the barbs to achieve a secure, watertight seal. Whether used in irrigation, pond filtration, or household water projects, it helps maintain neat and organised hose routing while protecting hoses from kinking. Combining reliability, strength, and ease of use, this connector is an essential accessory for gardeners, pond enthusiasts, and DIY users who need a cost-effective and long-lasting way to manage hose connections effectively.

product.name: Double Tap Connector with Valves & 4mm Micro Barb Outlets
product.description:
The Double Tap Connector with Valves & Threaded Outlets in Black/Orange is a versatile and efficient solution for managing water flow from a single source. Designed with a 1 BSP Female and 3/4 BSP Female inlet, this connector is compatible with most standard taps and water sources. It provides two separate 3/4 BSP Male outlets, allowing users to direct water to multiple locations or devices simultaneously, making it an ideal choice for garden irrigation, outdoor cleaning, or other water distribution needs.
One of the key features of this connector is its independent control valves, which enable precise flow regulation for each outlet. Whether you need full pressure on one side and a trickle on the other, the adjustable valves allow for customized water flow to meet specific requirements. product.description: Pegdev Detectable Sewer Pipe Mesh is designed to provide a clear and highly visible warning for buried underground sewer pipes during excavation work. Designed to be clearly visible when pulled up in an excavator bucket, the mesh provides an obvious warning to groundworkers and excavation teams. The integrated detectable wire allows the mesh to be located from the surface, providing an additional method of identifying underground sewer pipe routes before or during groundworks. This durable warning mesh is suitable for contractors, builders, utility companies, landscapers and groundworkers working on construction and excavation projects. The mesh is rot resistant and manufactured from durable HDPE to withstand demanding underground conditions, providing a long-lasting solution for underground service identification. The repeated warning message provides clear visual identification when the mesh is uncovered.
